intro: This 8 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 review brings together unofficial candidate reports. The shift cards show section difficulty and recalled topics from the remaining sources. Some reviews have limited evidence and need further corroboration. Exam-wide survey averages are excluded from shift-specific good-attempt estimates; an unavailable total means no reliable recommendation is being made. SSC publishes the official answer key and applies its own score normalisation.

faqs.q: What difficulty was reported on 8 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 1: Easy to Moderate (most reports); Shift 2: Easy to Moderate (reports differ); Shift 3: Easy to Moderate (reports differ). These are unofficial candidate-review summaries.

faqs.q: Is the analysis for 8 October 2026 complete and official?
faqs.a: Read the individual shift pages for source coverage, recalled topics and correction notes. The analysis is not an official paper or SSC statement.

faqs.q: Why are some good-attempt figures unavailable for 8 October 2026?
faqs.a: A pooled survey average, accuracy percentage or conflicting total does not establish how many questions were safe to attempt in a particular shift. Those figures are withheld rather than replaced with guesses.
